items.title: For a flat morphism the shriek of the structure sheaf is a relative dualizing complex

items.difficulty_reason: In Situation labelled situation-shriek, for a flat morphism f : X -> Y of FTS_S, the lemma asserts that f^!O_Y is the first component of a relative dualizing complex for X over Y in the sense of Definition labelled definition-relative-dualizing-complex (statement lines 7588-7620). By Lemma labelled lemma-flat-shriek-relatively-perfect the object f^!O_Y is Y-perfect, so it remains to check the comparison map along the diagonal (proof lines 7622-7636). Since f is separated, the diagonal Delta : X -> X x_Y X is a closed immersion and Delta_*Delta^!(-) = RSheafHom_{O_{X x_Y X}}(O_X, -) by Lemmas labelled lemma-twisted-inverse-image-closed and lemma-sheaf-with-exact-support-ext, so it suffices to show Delta^!(Lpr_1^*f^!O_Y) = O_X (proof lines 7636-7644). The proof computes O_X = Delta^!pr_1^!O_X = Delta^!pr_1^!Lpr_2^*O_Y = Delta^!(Lpr_1^*f^!O_Y), where the last step is the base change isomorphism pr_1^! o Lpr_2^* = Lpr_1^* o f^! of Lemma labelled lemma-base-change-shriek-flat (proof lines 7646-7652). Recognising that the relative dualizing condition reduces to a computation along the diagonal, and discharging it with the flat base change for the shriek, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
